headline: President Clinton added the Small Business Administration to the President's Export Council, a group that advises the President on trade and exports.
what_it_does: This order adds the Small Business Administration (SBA) as a member of the President's Export Council. The Council advises the President on ways to increase U.S. exports. No summary was provided, so other details of the order are not known.

who_it_affects.how: The agency gains a seat on the President's Export Council.
The Council's membership grows to include the Small Business Administration.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, March 6, 1996 (no effective date stated in the material provided).
